name: Zen Chakraborty
role: Truant network runner — message courier for the Shelf's informal economy
location: The Shelf (operates between Brewer's Spine and Copperhead), near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Wren is small for her age, which she treats as professional equipment. She has her mother's deep brown skin and her father's pale Icelandic freckles scattered across her nose and cheeks in a pattern that looks almost deliberate, like someone scattered rust-colored seeds. Her hair is cropped close on one side and grows in tight coils on the other — not a style choice, the result of a geneware dye-job gone sideways that fused color-cycling pigment into about forty percent of her scalp. The affected half cycles through muted greens and grays, which she has decided is actually cooler than what she originally paid for. She moves through the Shelf's maintenance corridors and pipe-crawl shortcuts with the confidence of someone who has mentally mapped every possible escape route, because she has.

She is not a happy child but she is an effective one. There is a watchfulness in her eyes that belongs to someone twice her age, and she has learned to keep her observations private until they are useful. She is politely transactional with most adults, reserving genuine warmth only for the handful of people who have proved they won't exploit it. She has a fierce and private devotion to a local E.L.F. she calls the Creak-God — a spirit she believes inhabits the Brewer's Spine maintenance tunnels — and leaves it small data offerings (recorded ambient sounds, mostly) wrapped in old wire.

core_fears: being trapped somewhere she can't escape
becoming dependent on someone who will leave
core_desires: enough Quanta saved to buy her own locked room
to be known by one person who won't use what they know
coping_mechanisms: ritual offerings to the Creak-God before anything risky
blind_spots: underestimates how much people can see through her transactional mask
believes self-sufficiency is the same as safety
psychology.secret: She knows the location of a dead courier's stash — Φ340 and a sealed data chip — hidden behind a pipe junction in tunnel 7-G. She hasn't touched it in six months. The courier was twelve. She keeps delivering past that junction every day.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Sparse and precise. Drops articles. Uses distance and direction like currency — 'two lefts and a drop, watch the third rung.' Avoids the word 'home.'
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick and flat, information-dense. Slows down only when she's lying or afraid.
verbal_tics: pauses before proper nouns as if checking they're safe to say
example_lines: 'Two quanta now, one when I'm back. That's how it works.'
'Creak-God had a good morning. Corridor 7 is clear, probably.'

story_hooks: The sealed data chip she refuses to touch contains information someone very dangerous is looking for — and they've started asking about small couriers who run tunnel 7-G.
A new corporate school recruiter has noticed her spatial memory and route efficiency and is offering a scholarship; Wren is terrified of what she'd owe.
narrative_function: Local color and unexpected information source; players may hire her as a guide through the Shelf's hidden passages; she knows things she hasn't told anyone yet.
augmentations: Partial cosmetic geneware — color-cycling hair pigment (malfunctioning, affects only left side of scalp). No chrome.
daily_life: Picks up message packets at the Creak-God's shrine each morning, runs them through tunnel routes she's memorized, collects Φ2-5 per delivery. Eats whatever the market stalls leave at end of day.
affiliation: Independent; loosely connected to Brewer's Spine informal market traders

decision_rules: always have two exits before committing to an entry
don't accept payment in advance from strangers
never run the same route twice on the same day
escalation_ladder: create distance and find high ground
run a decoy route and disappear into tunnels

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Polite, professional, reveals nothing personal. Quotes prices immediately.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Marginally warmer but still watchful; shows care through small useful actions rather than words.

stress_responses.low: Goes quiet, runs the route faster
stress_responses.medium: Finds the nearest tunnel access, waits and observes
stress_responses.high: Full silent vanish — knows nine ways out of any block on her routes

contradictions: Distrusts dependence but checks on specific stall-keepers every single day to make sure they're there
habits: touches the third pipe junction in tunnel 7-G and whispers the dead courier's name
breaking_points: direct threat to the Creak-God's shrine
discovering someone she trusted sold information about her routes

related_entities: Street Custom 'Copperhead' Battery Acid Squirt Gun

physical_description.heritage: South Asian with significant Southeast Asian, Middle Eastern, and North African admixture. Predominantly Bengali-Tamil genetic heritage with Khmer, Thai, and Persian influences creating a striking multicontinental phenotype.
physical_description.build: Slight and wiry for her age, all lean muscle from constant movement through maintenance crawlways. No fat reserves — undernourished but functionally strong.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with color-cycling geneware malfunction: left side cycles through muted greens and grays, right side natural tight coils
physical_description.hair_style: Asymmetrical undercut — cropped close on left (augmented) side, tight coils shoulder-length on right (natural) side
physical_description.hair_length: Short on left / Medium on right
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-to-deep brown with subtle golden undertones, characteristic of South Asian-Southeast Asian blending. Naturally luminous despite malnutrition.
physical_description.complexion: High, defined cheekbones with Southeast Asian angular structure. Skin shows minor scrapes and calluses from pipe-crawling. Fine facial features with South Asian softness blending Southeast Asian angularity. Warm brown complexion unmarked by significant freckling. No makeup.
distinguishing_marks: Faint chemical burn scar on left temple (hairline) from the geneware dye-job malfunction
Small calluses on palms and fingers from climbing, gripping, and handling wire
Scuff marks and minor abrasions on knees and elbows from regular maintenance corridor crawling
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left scalp geneware with color-cycling malfunction (cycles muted green-gray). No chrome or visible cybernetics. Augmentation is partially cosmetic, partially consequence of failed modification.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision through tight spaces — shoulders slightly forward, head alert. Sits low and balanced, ready to move instantly. Makes minimal eye contact with strangers but when she does, her gaze is penetrating and assessing. Walks quietly, avoids drawing attention. Fidgets with wire or small objects when still.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5 functional wear — patched cargo pants (multiple pockets for message packets), oversized thermal underlayer in faded gray, worn synth-leather jacket held together with repurposed wire loops. No logos or brand markers. Shoes are mismatched but functional (one synthetic, one fabric). Carries a homemade messenger bag made from repurposed industrial netting and metal clasps. Everything is repair-patched and weathered from tunnel use. No jewelry except a single length of twisted wire looped around her left wrist.
